title: Road Hazard Protection Credit on Alignment Services & Plans Renewals
content:
A road hazard renewal credit is taken off the renewal price of an expired Alignment Services & Plans month-based plan, according to the Road Hazard Protection certificate the vehicle's tires carry:

- **15.00** when the vehicle's tires carry an active Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection or Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate;
- **7.50** when they carry another active road hazard certificate;
- **0.00** when they carry none.

Only an active certificate on the renewed vehicle counts. The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the renewal price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

| Certificate on the vehicle's tires (hypothetical) | Credit |
|---|---|
| active Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection | 15.00 |
| active Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection | 7.50 |
| expired certificate only | 0.00 |
